_comment: exp/nextgen-fin +-45-SKIN architecture, sweep 2 -- gap-fill the thin end. s1 showed twill_3k_198 @ 45 skins over 1 UD core pair (through 1.03 mm) gives flex 17 N MID with k_twist ~40k (2.4x the 16249 baseline!) at theta_at_probe 118.9 deg -- a near-perfect match to the baseline's 118.3, so the twist beat is real. That design is ~1.5 N stiffer than the -2 N target; s2 thins the UD core to a single mid ply to bring flex down to ~13.5 while the +-45 skins keep the torsion margin. NO BIAX.
_targets: flex W(90) ~13.5 N (baseline 15.52 - 2), kick MID f~0.46, k_twist > 16249 N.mm/rad at theta_at_probe ~118 deg (matched).
